I was a little scared when it first seemed to drop out of nowhere besides the original dev logs *months* ago, I thought the whole transition from 2D to 3D would kill it before it got off the ground, but boy was I wrong. I’ve been loving every moment with all 5 of the characters I have (I’ve still yet to bother with the artificier), huntress still has her run and shoot ability, but everyone can move and shoot too now, making everyone a lot more fun. Commando is everything I could’ve asked for, and Mercenary is the best melee playstyle I’ve had ever. Engineer is also pretty fun (I’ve never liked his playstyle, but he fills his old role even better), and MUL-T is a rollercoaster I can barely begin to describe. Keep in mind that it’s still early access, but It’s an absolute blast, even with so much still unfinished.
